summary: The model over-splits disfluent spoken clauses right at causal/conditional/sequential connectives, severing reason-result or condition-result links and sometimes leaving predicate-less fragments; meanwhile it systematically leaves whole sentences with clear leading discourse markers, conditional endings, or question-then-purpose boundaries unsplit, forfeiting free latency gains. The fix is boundary placement relative to clause dependency (predicate/scope completeness), not fewer or more tags overall.
